mapper.select: SELECT uuid, task_id, status, result_summary, result_json, error_message, started_time, finished_time FROM sys_scheduled_task_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY started_time DESC, uuid DESC
SELECT uuid, task_id, status, result_summary, result_json, error_message, started_time, finished_time FROM sys_scheduled_task_run WHERE uuid = #{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_scheduled_task_run (uuid, task_id, status, result_summary, result_json, error_message, started_time, finished_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{taskId}, #{status}, #{resultSummary}, #{resultJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startedTime}, #{finishedTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_scheduled_task_run SET status = #{status}, result_summary = #{resultSummary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, result_json = #{resultJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message = #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND status = 0
